title: What to expect from Creating an Account

question.author: member_102
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for creating an account?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Getting Started documentation says: Create a CloudBox account with your email address and a password of at least 12 characters, then verify your email address to activate it. Personal accounts can optionally enable two-factor authentication in the Security panel; organization accounts are required to enroll in 2FA by their administrator's policy (mandatory for all orgs since CloudBox 2.1). You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from the billing portal. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
